subject: DI05005051

body.en:
Definition

A fertilizer is a material applied to supply one or more essential plant nutrients in a form that can contribute to plant nutrition. Its main purpose is nutrient supply;not every soil amendment, plant stimulant or microbial inoculant is the same kind of fertilizer.

Need and nutrient balance

Harvest removes nutrients from the field;leaching, erosion and gaseous loss can further reduce available supply. Soils may contain nutrients butnot enough plant-available forms at the required time. Fertilizers help correct an identified nutrient limitation and support crop productivity, quality and nutrient replacement.

Supply must be matched to soil/crop requirements. More fertilizer is not always better:excess can cause salt injury, unbalanced growth, loss to water/air and unnecessary cost. Fertilizer cannot by itself correct poor drainage, drought, disease or every soil-structure problem.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Plant nutrition માં ફાળો આપી શકે તેવા સ્વરૂપમાં એક અથવા વધુ essential nutrients supply કરવા અપાતો material fertilizer છે. તેનો મુખ્ય હેતુ nutrient supply છે;દરેક soil amendment, plant stimulant અથવા microbial inoculant એક જ પ્રકારનું fertilizer નથી.

જરૂરિયાત તથા Nutrient Balance

Harvest થી nutrients field ની બહાર જાય છે;leaching, erosion તથા gaseous loss થી available supply વધુ ઘટે છે. Soil માં nutrient હોવા છતાં જરૂરી સમયે પૂરતું plant-available form ન હોઈ શકે. Fertilizer identified nutrient limitation સુધારી crop productivity, quality તથા nutrient replacement માં મદદ કરે છે.

Supply soil/crop requirement મુજબ હોવી જોઈએ. વધુ fertilizer હંમેશાં વધુ લાભદાયી નથી:excess થી salt injury, unbalanced growth, water/air losses તથા cost વધે છે. Fertilizer એકલું poor drainage, drought, disease અથવા દરેક soil-structure problem સુધારતું નથી.

body.en:
By nutrient supplied

Nitrogenous:urea, ammonium sulphate;phosphatic:SSP, TSP;potassic:KCl, K2SO4.Secondary-nutrient fertilizers supply Ca, Mg or S;micronutrient fertilizers supply an identified micronutrient such as Zn or B.A fertilizer may supply several nutrients:ammonium sulphate supplies N and S.

Straight, complex and mixed

A straight fertilizer supplies one of the primary nutrients N, P, K;it may also contain secondary nutrients. A complex/compound fertilizer contains two or more primary nutrients through its manufacturing route, typically with nutrients combined within product granules. Examples include DAP and selected compound NPK grades. A bulk-blended/mixed fertilizer is a physical mixture of compatible component fertilizers;the components need not be in each individual granule.

The syllabus groups CAN with complex fertilizers for study. CAN is commonly a specified ammonium-nitrate/mineral-carbonate product rather than a unique pure molecular complex;do not infer chemical identity solely from the unit heading.

Other classification bases

By source:organic, manufactured mineral/inorganic, and biological inoculants described separately. By physical form:solid powders/granules, liquids and specified gases. By release:readily soluble, slow-release or controlled-release where a defined technology supports the claim. These bases overlap;organic does not mean nutrient-free or automatically safe.
body.gu:
Nutrient પ્રમાણે

Nitrogenous:urea, ammonium sulphate;phosphatic:SSP, TSP;potassic:KCl, K2SO4. Secondary-nutrient fertilizers Ca, Mg/S તથા micronutrient fertilizers Zn/B જેવા nutrients આપે છે. એક fertilizer એકથી વધુ nutrients આપી શકે:ammonium sulphate N તથા S આપે છે.

Straight, Complex તથા Mixed

Straight fertilizer એક primary nutrient N, P/K આપે છે, સાથે secondary nutrients હોઈ શકે. Complex/compound fertilizer manufacturing route થી બે કે વધુ primary nutrients આપે છે અને સામાન્ય રીતે product granules માં nutrients સાથે હોય છે;DAP તથા selected compound NPK examples છે. Bulk-blended/mixed fertilizer compatible components નું physical mixture છે;દરેક granule માં બધા components હોવા જરૂરી નથી.

Syllabus માં CAN complex unit માં છે. CAN specified ammonium-nitrate/mineral-carbonate product છે, unique pure molecular complex નહીં;unit heading થી chemical identity નક્કી ન કરવી.

અન્ય Classification Bases

Source મુજબ organic, manufactured mineral/inorganic તથા અલગ વર્ણવાતા biological inoculants. Physical form મુજબ solid powders/granules, liquids તથા specified gases. Release મુજબ readily soluble, slow-release તથા defined technology વાળા controlled-release. આ bases overlap થાય છે;organic એટલે nutrient-free અથવા આપમેળે safe નહીં.

body.en:
Essentiality and macro/micro distinction

An essential element is required for normal plant life-cycle completion and has a specific function that cannot simply be replaced by another element. Macronutrients are required in larger amounts;micronutrients in smaller amounts. Micro does not mean unimportant or that excess is harmless.

Macronutrients

C, H, O:major structural/metabolic building blocks, largely obtained through CO2 and water. Primary mineral nutrients:N supports proteins, nucleic acids and chlorophyll;P participates in energy transfer, nucleic acids and membranes;K supports enzyme activation, osmotic regulation and stomatal function. Secondary mineral nutrients:Ca contributes to cell walls/membranes and signalling;Mg is central to chlorophyll and enzyme functions;S occurs in sulfur-containing amino acids and proteins.

Micronutrients

Fe supports electron-transfer and enzyme systems;Mn supports photosynthetic/enzyme reactions;Zn contributes to enzyme/protein functions;Cu participates in redox enzymes;B supports cell-wall/reproductive functions;Mo is a cofactor in nitrate reduction and biological nitrogen fixation;Cl contributes to ionic balance/photosynthetic function;Ni is required for urease function.

Symptoms alone are not a definitive soil/plant diagnosis. Deficiency, toxicity, pH and root damage can produce overlapping signs. Use qualified testing and agronomic interpretation rather than prescribing micronutrient doses from a picture.
body.gu:
Essentiality તથા Macro/Micro નો ભેદ

Normal plant life cycle પૂર્ણ કરવા જરૂરી તથા બીજા element થી સરળતાથી replace ન થઈ શકે તેવું specific function ધરાવતો element essential છે. Macronutrients મોટા અને micronutrients નાના amounts માં જોઈએ. Micro એટલે ઓછું મહત્વનું અથવા excess harmless નથી.

Macronutrients

C, H, O structural/metabolic building blocks છે, મુખ્યત્વે CO2/water થી મળે છે. Primary mineral nutrients:N proteins, nucleic acids/chlorophyll માં;P energy transfer, nucleic acids/membranes માં;K enzyme activation, osmotic regulation તથા stomatal function માં મદદ કરે છે. Secondary nutrients:Ca cell walls/membranes/signalling માં;Mg chlorophyll તથા enzymes માં;S sulfur-containing amino acids/proteins માં છે.

Micronutrients

Fe electron-transfer/enzyme systems માં, Mn photosynthetic/enzyme reactions માં, Zn enzyme/protein functions માં, Cu redox enzymes માં તથા B cell-wall/reproductive functions માં ફાળો આપે છે. Mo nitrate reduction/biological N fixation નો cofactor છે;Cl ionic balance/photosynthesis માં અને Ni urease function માં જરૂરી છે.

ફક્ત symptoms થી definitive diagnosis ન થાય. Deficiency, toxicity, pH તથા root damage ના signs overlap થઈ શકે છે. Picture પરથી dose prescribe કરતાં qualified testing/agronomic interpretation જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
Methods

Broadcasting spreads a permitted solid grade over the intended area;band/placement locates nutrients in a selected root-zone region. Top dressing supplies nutrients during crop growth where appropriate. Fertigation delivers a compatible, fully suitable soluble formulation through a qualified irrigation system. Foliar application uses a suitable product on leaves and is not a universal replacement for root-zone nutrient supply.

Selection and precautions

Choose the right source, rate, time and place using soil/plant tests, crop need, weather and authorised product guidance. This chapter does not prescribe field doses. Avoid seed/root contact injury, losses before heavy rain, uncontrolled drift and incompatible mixes. Water solubility, chloride sensitivity, release behaviour and irrigation-water chemistry affect method choice.

Store compatible products separately as required, keep labels intact and protect nutrient-rich runoff from entering waterways. Workers must follow product safety requirements and use the specified handling equipment.
body.gu:
Methods

Broadcasting માં permitted solid grade area માં ફેલાય છે;band/placement માં nutrients selected root-zone region માં મૂકાય છે. Top dressing crop growth દરમિયાન યોગ્ય સમયે supply આપે છે. Fertigation માં compatible suitable soluble formulation qualified irrigation system થી અપાય છે. Foliar application suitable product leaves પર આપે છે;તે root-zone supply નો universal replacement નથી.

Selection તથા Precautions

Soil/plant tests, crop need, weather તથા authorised guidance થી right source, rate, time/place પસંદ કરો. અહીં field doses આપેલ નથી. Seed/root contact injury, heavy rain પહેલાં loss, drift તથા incompatible mixes ટાળો. Solubility, chloride sensitivity, release behaviour તથા irrigation-water chemistry થી method નક્કી થાય છે.

Compatibility મુજબ products store કરો, labels જાળવો તથા nutrient-rich runoff waterways માં જતું રોકો. Product safety requirements તથા specified handling equipment અનુસરો.

body.en:
Basis and formula

1.State the exact chemical formula, hydration state and whether the sample is pure or a commercial grade.

2.Calculate formula mass M=Σ(number of atoms×atomic mass).

3.Nutrient-element mass fraction=mass of that element in one formula unit/M.

4.Element%=mass fraction×100.

5.P2O5 equivalent=P%×141.94/(2×30.974)=P%×2.2914.

6.K2O equivalent=K%×94.20/(2×39.098)=K%×1.2046.

7.The label N–P–K convention reports%N–%P2O5 equivalent–%K2O equivalent;it does not assert these oxides physically occur in the bag.

Inverse conversions and commercial basis

P%=P2O5 equivalent%×0.4364;K%=K2O equivalent%×0.8301.For a known blend, nutrient mass is the sum over components:Σ(component mass×its nutrient fraction).Divide by final blend mass, including every retained carrier/moisture component.

Commercial moisture, impurities, coatings and formulation composition can make actual grade lower than the ideal pure-compound value. Never substitute a theoretical number for the certified product analysis.

1.Exact formula, hydration તથા pure/commercial basis લખો.

2.M=Σ(atom count×atomic mass).

3.Element mass fraction=formula માં element ની mass/M.

4.Element%=fraction×100.

5.P2O5 equivalent=P%×141.94/(2×30.974)=P%×2.2914.

6.K2O equivalent=K%×94.20/(2×39.098)=K%×1.2046.

7.N–P–Klabel=%N–%P2O5 equivalent–%K2O equivalent છે;bag માં actual oxide molecules છે એવો અર્થ નથી.

Inverse Conversions તથા Commercial Basis

P%=P2O5 equivalent%×0.4364;K%=K2O equivalent%×0.8301. Known blend માં nutrient mass=Σ(component mass×તેનો nutrient fraction). Final blend ની total mass થી divide કરો;retained carrier/moisture પણ ગણો.

Commercial moisture, impurities, coatings/formulation થી actual grade pure-compound theoretical value કરતાં ઓછી હોઈ શકે છે. Certified analysis ની જગ્યાએ theoretical number ન મૂકવો.

body.en:
Given → Find → Calculation

1.Given:CO(NH2)2;C=12.01,O=16.00,N=14.01,H=1.008.

2.Find:theoretical%N.

3.M=12.01+16.00+2(14.01)+4(1.008)=60.062g/mol.

4.N mass=28.02g/mol.

5.%N=28.02/60.062×100=46.65%.This is the ideal pure-urea value, not an untested commercial certificate.

Secondary mineral nutrients:Ca contributes to cell walls/membranes and signalling;Mg is central to chlorophyll and enzyme functions;S occurs in sulfur-containing amino acids and proteins.
a.gu: Normal plant life cycle પૂર્ણ કરવા જરૂરી તથા બીજા element થી સરળતાથી replace ન થઈ શકે તેવું specific function ધરાવતો element essential છે. Macronutrients મોટા અને micronutrients નાના amounts માં જોઈએ. Micro એટલે ઓછું મહત્વનું અથવા excess harmless નથી. C, H, O structural/metabolic building blocks છે, મુખ્યત્વે CO2/water થી મળે છે. Primary mineral nutrients:N proteins, nucleic acids/chlorophyll માં;P energy transfer, nucleic acids/membranes માં;K enzyme activation, osmotic regulation તથા stomatal function માં મદદ કરે છે. Secondary nutrients:Ca cell walls/membranes/signalling માં;Mg chlorophyll તથા enzymes માં;S sulfur-containing amino acids/proteins માં છે.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Fertilizer application—principles and methods.
q.gu: Fertilizer Application—Principles તથા Methodsનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Broadcasting spreads a permitted solid grade over the intended area;band/placement locates nutrients in a selected root-zone region. Top dressing supplies nutrients during crop growth where appropriate. Fertigation delivers a compatible, fully suitable soluble formulation through a qualified irrigation system. Foliar application uses a suitable product on leaves and is not a universal replacement for root-zone nutrient supply. Choose the right source, rate, time and place using soil/plant tests, crop need, weather and authorised product guidance. This chapter does not prescribe field doses. Avoid seed/root contact injury, losses before heavy rain, uncontrolled drift and incompatible mixes. Water solubility, chloride sensitivity, release behaviour and irrigation-water chemistry affect method choice.
a.gu: Broadcasting માં permitted solid grade area માં ફેલાય છે;band/placement માં nutrients selected root-zone region માં મૂકાય છે. Top dressing crop growth દરમિયાન યોગ્ય સમયે supply આપે છે. Fertigation માં compatible suitable soluble formulation qualified irrigation system થી અપાય છે. Foliar application suitable product leaves પર આપે છે;તે root-zone supply નો universal replacement નથી. Soil/plant tests, crop need, weather તથા authorised guidance થી right source, rate, time/place પસંદ કરો. અહીં field doses આપેલ નથી. Seed/root contact injury, heavy rain પહેલાં loss, drift તથા incompatible mixes ટાળો. Solubility, chloride sensitivity, release behaviour તથા irrigation-water chemistry થી method નક્કી થાય છે.
